question: How is the division of directions grounded in both world and scripture?
premises: The division of directions is established in ordinary experience and in scripture.
Sadāśiva is taught as having a body composed of five mantras.
This fivefold form provides a scriptural basis for directional order.
inference: The worldly division of directions corresponds to the five-mantra form of Sadāśiva taught in scripture.
uncertainties: The verse bridges into the next explanation; the full mapping is completed in 204-206.
plain_english: The division of directions is established both in the world and in scripture, for Sadāśiva is taught in sequence as having a body made of five mantras.
